title: Orchestra Orchestration
description: Schema for Orchestra orchestration definition files (.json and .yaml). Defines a DAG of steps (Prompt, Http, Transform, Command, Script, Orchestration) with triggers, MCP servers, subagents, retry policies, and template expressions.
$comment: Template expressions use the {{namespace.property}} syntax. Recognized namespaces: param.<name>, vars.<name>, env.<VAR>, orchestration.{name|version|runId|startedAt|tempDir|sourcePath|sourceDirectory}, step.{name|type}, server.url, and <stepName>.{output|rawOutput|files|files[N]}. For steps of type Orchestration the referenced step additionally supports: <stepName>.{executionId|status|errorMessage|completionReason|childResult|steps} and <stepName>.steps.<childStepName>.{output|rawOutput|error|status|files|files[N]}. This schema cannot semantically validate template targets (e.g., that the referenced step exists or is reachable via DependsOn); the C# TemplateExpressionValidator does that at orchestration registration time. See docs/engine.md#template-expressions for the authoritative reference.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this orchestration does.

version.description: Semantic version for tracking orchestration changes.

steps.description: Array of step definitions forming a directed acyclic graph (DAG). Steps execute in dependency order.

trigger.description: Trigger configuration. Defaults to manual (no automated trigger).

mcps.description: Inline MCP (Model Context Protocol) server definitions. Merged with global orchestra.mcp.json definitions at runtime (inline takes priority on name conflicts).

defaultSystemPromptMode.description: Default system prompt mode for all Prompt steps. Individual steps can override. When null, the SDK's default behavior is used.

defaultRetryPolicy.description: Default retry policy applied to all steps that don't define their own. When absent, no retries are performed.

defaultModel.description: Default model applied to all Prompt steps that don't define their own model. When absent, each Prompt step must specify its own model.

agentPool.description: Provider-neutral agent worker pool settings for this orchestration run. Providers decide how to map instances to resources such as CLI clients. Values are treated as requests and may be capped by host/provider configuration.

defaultStepTimeoutSeconds.description: Default timeout in seconds applied to all steps that don't define their own timeoutSeconds. When absent, steps without an explicit timeout run with no per-step timeout (only the orchestration-level timeout applies).

timeoutSeconds.description: Maximum time in seconds for the entire orchestration to complete. When elapsed, all running steps are cancelled. Default is 0 (disabled — no orchestration-level timeout). Set to a positive value to enforce a wall-clock cap.

variables.description: User-defined variables available to all steps via {{vars.name}} template expressions. Values may contain template expressions (e.g., {{param.project}}) which are resolved lazily.

tags.description: Author-defined tags for categorizing the orchestration. Used by profiles to filter and group orchestrations.

inputs.description: Typed input schema for the orchestration. When defined, this is the authoritative source of truth for parameter definitions, providing types, descriptions, required flags, defaults, and enum constraints. When absent, the orchestration falls back to legacy behavior: parameter names collected from step-level 'parameters' arrays, treated as required strings.

hooks.description: Optional lifecycle hooks that run after step or orchestration outcomes. Hooks receive structured JSON payloads through stdin and can execute follow-up scripts.

metadata.description: Free-form metadata for the orchestration. Purely informational - never inspected by the runtime. Use for authorship, datetime, ticket links, environment, SLA, or any other semi-structured data that orchestration authors and managers want to record. Values may be any JSON type (string, number, boolean, object, array).

pauseTimeoutDuringWait.description: When true, the orchestration timeout clock pauses while a step (Approval or orchestra_request_user_input) is waiting for human input. Set to false for hard SLAs that include human response latency.

defaultEnableTools.description: Opt-in engine tool names enabled by default for every Prompt step that does not specify its own enableTools. Currently supports 'request_user_input'.

step.description: A single step in the orchestration DAG.

name.description: Unique step name used for dependency references and template expressions (e.g., {{stepName.output}}).

dependsOn.description: Names of upstream steps that must complete before this step runs.

parameters.description: For most step types, parameter names this step requires. For Orchestration steps, child orchestration parameter values.

enabled.description: When false, the step is skipped during execution.

timeoutSeconds.description: Per-step timeout in seconds. Overrides defaultStepTimeoutSeconds. Set to 0 to disable even when a default is set.

minInstances.description: Minimum provider workers to keep ready for this orchestration run. 0 disables prewarming.

maxInstances.description: Maximum provider workers that may be created for this orchestration run.

maxSessionsPerInstance.description: Maximum active prompt sessions each provider worker may host concurrently.

idleTimeoutSeconds.description: Seconds an idle provider worker above minInstances may remain alive before the provider shrinks the pool. 0 disables idle shrink.

promptStepProperties.description: Properties specific to Prompt steps. Sends prompts to an LLM model, optionally with MCP tools, subagents, and loop/checker patterns.

systemPrompt.description: System prompt text sent to the LLM. Mutually exclusive with systemPromptFile. Supports template expressions: {{param.X}}, {{vars.X}}, {{env.X}}, {{orchestration.X}}, {{server.url}}, {{step.name}}, {{stepName.output|rawOutput|files|files[N]}}. For Orchestration step dependencies additionally: {{stepName.executionId|status|errorMessage|completionReason|childResult|steps|steps.<childStep>.{output|rawOutput|error|status|files|files[N]}}.
examples: You are an expert reviewer for {{param.repoName}}.
Use the context from {{fetch-data.output}} to answer.

systemPromptFile.description: Path to a file containing the system prompt. Relative paths are resolved from the orchestration file directory. Supports {{vars.*}} expressions. Mutually exclusive with systemPrompt.

userPrompt.description: User prompt text sent to the LLM. Supports template expressions: {{param.X}}, {{vars.X}}, {{env.X}}, {{orchestration.X}}, {{server.url}}, {{step.name}}, {{stepName.output|rawOutput|files|files[N]}}. For Orchestration step dependencies additionally: {{stepName.executionId|status|errorMessage|completionReason|childResult|steps|steps.<childStep>.{output|rawOutput|error|status|files|files[N]}}. Mutually exclusive with userPromptFile.

userPromptFile.description: Path to a file containing the user prompt. Relative paths are resolved from the orchestration file directory. Supports {{vars.*}} expressions. Mutually exclusive with userPrompt.

inputHandlerPrompt.description: Optional LLM prompt to preprocess/transform input before the main prompt. Mutually exclusive with inputHandlerPromptFile.

inputHandlerPromptFile.description: Path to a file containing the input handler prompt. Mutually exclusive with inputHandlerPrompt.

outputHandlerPrompt.description: Optional LLM prompt to postprocess/transform the model's raw output. Mutually exclusive with outputHandlerPromptFile.

outputHandlerPromptFile.description: Path to a file containing the output handler prompt. Mutually exclusive with outputHandlerPrompt.

reasoningLevel.description: Reasoning/thinking level for the model. Controls depth of chain-of-thought.

reasoningSummary.description: Verbosity of the model's reasoning summary (none/concise/detailed). Maps to the Copilot SDK ReasoningSummary.

contextTier.description: Context-window tier (default/longContext). Opts the step into the model's extended context window where supported.

workingDirectory.description: Working directory for the agent's shell/file tools and config discovery (custom instructions, .github/agents, .github/mcp.json). Supports ${env:*}/{{vars.*}}; validated to exist at run time.

githubToken.description: GitHub token for this step's Copilot session, overriding the host default. Supports ${env:GITHUB_TOKEN}. Avoid hardcoding secrets; prefer an env reference.

humanInput.description: When true, the agent's elicitation and exit-plan-mode (plan approval) requests for this step are routed to Orchestra's human-in-the-loop (UI/CLI/API) instead of resolving autonomously.

systemPromptMode.description: How the system prompt interacts with the SDK's default system prompt. Overrides defaultSystemPromptMode.

mcps.description: Names of MCP servers this step can use. Must match names defined in the orchestration-level or global MCP definitions.

loop.description: Loop/checker configuration. After this step runs, checks output against exitPattern. If not matched, re-runs the target step with feedback, up to maxIterations times.

subagents.description: Subagents that the main step orchestrator can delegate to. The runtime auto-selects based on user intent when 'infer' is true.

skillDirectories.description: Paths to directories containing Agent Skills (SKILL.md files). Relative paths are resolved from the orchestration file directory. Skills provide specialized knowledge and workflows the agent can discover and activate on demand.

systemPromptSections.description: Section-level overrides for the system prompt. Used with systemPromptMode: customize to surgically control specific sections.

action.description: The action to apply to this section.

content.description: The content for replace, append, or prepend actions.

infiniteSessions.description: Configuration for infinite sessions (automatic context compaction).

enabled.description: Whether infinite sessions are enabled. Default: true (SDK default).

backgroundCompactionThreshold.description: Context utilization ratio (0.0-1.0) at which background compaction begins. Default: 0.80.

bufferExhaustionThreshold.description: Context utilization ratio (0.0-1.0) at which the session blocks until compaction completes. Default: 0.95.

attachments.description: Image attachments to send with the prompt. Supports file paths and base64 blob data.

type.description: Attachment type: 'file' for disk paths, 'blob' for inline base64 data.

path.description: Path to the image file (for type: file). Relative paths are resolved from the orchestration file directory. Supports template expressions.

data.description: Base64-encoded image data (for type: blob). Supports template expressions.

mimeType.description: MIME type of the image (for type: blob), e.g. 'image/png'.

displayName.description: Optional display name for the attachment.

enableTools.description: Opt-in engine tool names this Prompt step grants the agent access to. Currently supports 'request_user_input' (the LLM-decided human-in-the-loop tool). Falls back to the orchestration's defaultEnableTools when null.

httpStepProperties.description: Properties specific to Http steps. Makes HTTP requests to external services.

headers.description: HTTP request headers. Values support template expressions.

body.description: Request body content. Supports template expressions.

transformStepProperties.description: Properties specific to Transform steps. Performs template-based text transformation without calling an LLM.

template.description: Template string with {{...}} expressions resolved at runtime. Supports {{param.X}}, {{vars.X}}, {{env.X}}, {{orchestration.X}}, {{server.url}}, {{step.name}}, {{stepName.output|rawOutput|files|files[N]}}. For Orchestration step dependencies additionally: {{stepName.executionId|status|errorMessage|completionReason|childResult|steps|steps.<childStep>.{output|rawOutput|error|status|files|files[N]}}.

commandStepProperties.description: Properties specific to Command steps. Executes a local process/command.

arguments.description: Command arguments. Each argument supports template expressions.

workingDirectory.description: Working directory for the command. Relative paths are resolved from the orchestration file directory. Supports template expressions.

environment.description: Environment variables to set for the command process.

includeStdErr.description: When true, stderr output is included in the step's output alongside stdout.

stdin.description: Content to pipe to the command's standard input. Supports template expressions.

scriptStepProperties.description: Properties specific to Script steps. Executes an inline or file-based script using a specified shell interpreter (e.g., pwsh, bash, python). The script's stdout is captured as the step output.

script.description: Inline script content to execute. Supports template expressions. Mutually exclusive with scriptFile.

scriptFile.description: Path to an external script file. Relative paths are resolved from the orchestration file directory. Mutually exclusive with script.

arguments.description: Arguments passed to the script. Each argument supports template expressions.

workingDirectory.description: Working directory for the script process. Relative paths are resolved from the orchestration file directory. Supports template expressions.

environment.description: Environment variables to set for the script process.

includeStdErr.description: When true, stderr output is included in the step's output alongside stdout.

stdin.description: Content to pipe to the script's standard input. Supports template expressions.

strictMode.description: Controls how the executor wraps a PowerShell script (shell=pwsh|powershell) with an error-handling prologue. When unset (auto), the executor injects `$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; trap { Write-Error -ErrorRecord $_; exit 1 };` so terminating errors cause the step to be reported Failed instead of silently succeeding. When set to true, the executor additionally injects `Set-StrictMode -Version Latest` (catches uninitialized variables, missing properties, and out-of-bounds indexing) — use this for scripts written with strict-mode discipline. When set to false, no prologue is injected and the script runs verbatim. Non-PowerShell shells ignore this setting.

orchestrationStepProperties.description: Properties specific to Orchestration steps. Invokes another registered orchestration.

parameters.description: Child orchestration parameters. Values support template expressions resolved against the PARENT run's context: {{param.X}}, {{vars.X}}, {{env.X}}, {{orchestration.X}}, {{stepName.output|rawOutput|files|files[N]}}, and (for Orchestration step dependencies) {{stepName.executionId|status|errorMessage|completionReason|childResult|steps|steps.<childStep>.<leaf>}}. Values are passed to the child as strings at runtime.

orchestration.description: Registered child orchestration name or ID to invoke. Supports template expressions for dynamic selection: {{param.X}}, {{vars.X}}, {{env.X}}, {{orchestration.X}}, {{stepName.output|rawOutput}}, {{server.url}}.

mode.description: Invocation mode. sync waits for completion; async dispatches and continues.

inputHandlerPrompt.description: Optional LLM prompt to transform child parameters before the child orchestration starts. The handler must return a JSON object mapping parameter names to string values.

inputHandlerModel.description: Model to use for the input handler prompt. Defaults to the orchestration default model.

forEach.description: Optional template that resolves to a JSON array. When set, the step launches one child orchestration per element instead of a single child. Supports all standard template references: {{stepName.output}}, {{param.X}}, {{vars.X}}, etc. The resolved value must be a JSON array, or a JSON object containing the array at 'forEachPath'.

forEachPath.description: Optional dotted JSON path used to extract the items array out of 'forEach' when the template resolves to a JSON object. Example: when the prior step output is {"meetingsToProcess":[...]}, set this to 'meetingsToProcess'.

itemParameter.description: Required when 'forEach' is set. The name of the child parameter carrying the raw per-item JSON. The item is serialized as a compact JSON string and assigned to this parameter for every child invocation.

maxConcurrency.description: Maximum number of children to run concurrently in forEach mode. Defaults to unbounded. Honored only in sync mode.

continueOnItemFailure.description: In forEach + sync mode, when true the step succeeds even if some child invocations failed (the rollup captures per-item status). When false, any failed child fails the step.

approvalStepProperties.description: Properties specific to Approval steps. Pauses the orchestration and waits for human input via the host's HumanInput API. The user's response (choice or reply) becomes the step's output content. Survives host restarts.

prompt.description: Human-readable prompt presented to the user. Supports template expressions resolved at execution time.

choices.description: Allowed responses. When non-empty, the response endpoint validates that the supplied 'choice' is one of these (case-insensitive). When empty, free-form replies are accepted.

onTimeout.description: Behavior when timeoutSeconds fires without a response. 'fail' marks the step Failed; 'defaultResponse' uses the configured defaultResponse as the answer; 'cancel' cancels the entire orchestration.

defaultResponse.description: Required when onTimeout is 'defaultResponse'. The fallback content used as the step's output.

trigger.description: Trigger configuration determining how the orchestration is started.

inputHandlerPrompt.description: Optional LLM prompt to transform trigger input (e.g., webhook payload) into orchestration parameters.

inputHandlerModel.description: Model to use for the input handler prompt.

cron.description: Cron expression for scheduling (e.g., '0 */5 * * *'). Takes precedence over intervalSeconds if both are set.

intervalSeconds.description: Simple interval in seconds between runs. Used when cron is not set.

maxRuns.description: Maximum number of scheduled runs. When absent, runs indefinitely.

delaySeconds.description: Delay in seconds before re-running the orchestration after completion.

maxIterations.description: Maximum number of loop iterations. When absent, loops indefinitely.

continueOnFailure.description: Whether to continue looping after a failed run.

autoResume.description: When true, the host re-fires this loop on startup so the chain continues across host restarts. The first auto-resume fire respects delaySeconds measured from the most recent persisted run. Defaults to false.

secret.description: Optional secret for HMAC signature validation of incoming webhook requests. If set, requests must include a valid X-Webhook-Signature header.

maxConcurrent.description: Maximum number of concurrent executions triggered by webhooks.

webhookResponseConfig.description: Controls whether a webhook trigger returns the orchestration result synchronously in the HTTP response.

waitForResult.description: If true, the webhook HTTP handler awaits the orchestration result and returns it in the response body. If false, fires and forgets.

responseTemplate.description: Optional Handlebars-style template for formatting the response body. Supports {{stepName.Content}} placeholders. If absent, the raw OrchestrationResult is serialized as JSON.

timeoutSeconds.description: Maximum seconds to wait for the orchestration to complete before returning HTTP 504. Only used when waitForResult is true.

hook.description: Lifecycle hook definition. Hooks run in response to step or orchestration completion events and receive a structured JSON payload via stdin.

name.description: Optional name for diagnostics and logs.

when.description: Optional filter that decides whether the hook should run.

payload.description: Controls how much step data is included in the hook payload.

action.description: Action to execute when the hook fires.

failurePolicy.description: What to do if the hook action fails.

steps.description: Filter the hook based on the status of one or more named steps.

names.description: Optional list of step names to evaluate.

status.description: Status condition to test for the named steps.

match.description: Whether any or all named steps must satisfy the status condition.

detail.description: Preset payload detail level for included step records.

steps.description: Step records to include in the hook payload: a selector string or an explicit list of step names.

includeRefs.description: When true, includes API and MCP references for fetching more run data.

shell.description: Shell/interpreter to use when executing the hook script.

script.description: Inline script content. Mutually exclusive with scriptFile. The hook payload is provided through stdin.

scriptFile.description: Path to a script file. Mutually exclusive with script. Relative paths resolve from the orchestration file directory.

arguments.description: Optional arguments passed to the script.

workingDirectory.description: Optional working directory for the hook process. Relative paths resolve from the orchestration file directory.

environment.description: Optional environment variables for the hook process.

includeStdErr.description: When true, stderr is included in the script output if it succeeds.

mcp.description: MCP (Model Context Protocol) server definition. Provides tools to LLM steps.

name.description: Unique name for this MCP server. Referenced by steps via their 'mcps' array.

command.description: Executable to run for the local MCP server (e.g., 'npx', 'node', 'python').

arguments.description: Command-line arguments for the MCP server process.

workingDirectory.description: Working directory for the MCP server process. Relative paths are resolved from the orchestration file directory.

environment.description: Optional environment variables passed to the spawned MCP server process. Merged on top of the inherited host environment. Values may contain Orchestra template expressions ({{env.X}}, {{param.foo}}, {{step.output}}) that are resolved at step execution time.

timeoutSeconds.description: Optional per-server tool-call timeout in seconds. Accepts either a positive numeric literal or a template-string expression resolved at step execution time (e.g. "{{param.foo}}" or "{{validate-inputs.output.controllerMcpTimeoutSeconds}}"). Overrides the Copilot SDK's ~3-minute default MCP request timeout for this server. Use larger values for MCP servers that host long-running tools. For Orchestra's data-plane MCP (endpoints ending with /mcp/data), the host applies a default automatically when this field is omitted (see mcpServer.defaultOrchestraInvokeTimeoutSeconds); set this field to override that default per orchestration.

headers.description: HTTP headers to include when connecting to the remote MCP server.

timeoutSeconds.description: Optional per-server tool-call timeout in seconds. Accepts either a positive numeric literal or a template-string expression resolved at step execution time (e.g. "{{param.foo}}" or "{{validate-inputs.output.controllerMcpTimeoutSeconds}}"). Overrides the Copilot SDK's ~3-minute default MCP request timeout for this server. Use larger values for remote MCPs that host long-running tools (e.g., Orchestra's invoke_orchestration in sync mode). For Orchestra's data-plane MCP (endpoints ending with /mcp/data), the host applies a default automatically when this field is omitted (see mcpServer.defaultOrchestraInvokeTimeoutSeconds); set this field to override that default per orchestration.

maxRetries.description: Maximum number of retry attempts after the initial failure.

backoffSeconds.description: Initial backoff delay in seconds before the first retry.

backoffMultiplier.description: Multiplier applied to the backoff delay after each retry (exponential backoff).

retryOnTimeout.description: Whether to retry when a timeout error occurs.

loopConfig.description: Loop/checker configuration for iterative refinement patterns. The checker step evaluates output and can send the target step back for revision.

target.description: Name of the step to re-run if the exit pattern is not matched. Must be one of the step's dependsOn entries.

maxIterations.description: Maximum number of loop iterations before giving up.

exitPattern.description: String to search for in the checker step's output (case-insensitive). If found, the loop exits successfully.

subagent.description: A subagent that the main step orchestrator can delegate to. Subagents have their own system prompt, tool restrictions, and optional MCP servers.

name.description: Unique subagent identifier within the step.

displayName.description: Human-readable display name shown in events and UI.

description.description: Description of what the subagent does. Helps the runtime select the right subagent based on user intent.

prompt.description: System prompt defining the subagent's behavior. Mutually exclusive with promptFile.

promptFile.description: Path to a file containing the subagent's system prompt. Mutually exclusive with prompt.

tools.description: Tool name restrictions. When null/absent, all available tools are accessible. Use to restrict subagent capabilities (e.g., read-only tools).

mcps.description: Names of MCP servers this subagent can use. Must match names defined in orchestration-level or global MCP definitions.

infer.description: Whether the subagent should be available for automatic selection based on model inference. When true, the runtime can auto-select based on user intent.

inputDefinition.description: Typed input parameter definition with validation constraints.

description.description: Human-readable description of the input parameter.

required.description: Whether this input must be provided. When false and no value is given, 'default' is used.

default.description: Default value for optional inputs (stored as string, parsed according to 'type' at runtime).

enum.description: Allowed values constraint. Input value must match one of these (case-insensitive).

multiline.description: UI hint for string inputs that should be rendered as a multiline text area. Does not affect validation or execution.

systemPromptMode.description: How the custom system prompt interacts with the SDK's default system prompt. 'replace' completely replaces the SDK's built-in prompt. 'append' adds your prompt to the SDK's default, preserving built-in capabilities.

reasoningLevel.description: Reasoning/thinking level for the LLM model. Controls depth of chain-of-thought reasoning.

reasoningSummary.description: Verbosity of the model's reasoning summary surfaced during the step.

contextTier.description: Context-window tier for the step. 'longContext' opts into the model's extended context window where supported.
